deployments_detail.use: Microsoft 365 Copilot rolled out enterprise-wide for employee productivity (drafting, summarizing documents, data analysis, research). Expanded from a few hundred pilot users to roughly 20% of Dow's workforce; Dow is in Microsoft's Early Access and Compass Research programs and has used Copilot since April 2023. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]

AI agents built in Microsoft Copilot Studio to automate freight/shipping invoice analysis: an autonomous agent monitors incoming email for PDF invoices and structures the data, and a natural-language 'Freight Agent' lets logistics staff investigate billing anomalies. Proof-of-concept analyzed 43,000 North American land shipments; surfaced surcharge anomalies (e.g., a $30,000 charge vs typical $5,000). [Microsoft Copilot Studio / M365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: Dow anticipates saving millions of dollars in shipping costs in the first year once fully scaled

deployments_detail.use: Dow Digital Operations Center: part of a $400M digitalization investment, deploys drones and robots for safer, higher-quality asset inspection work, plus VR for engineering problem-solving and tracking of personnel and equipment, as part of Dow's Industry 4.0 manufacturing program. [none]
AI/ML "Predictive Intelligence" in Dow Polyurethanes for product development; AI+IoT ecosystem

SmartSearch for Dow: an AI-enabled molecule search/retrieval platform built with CAS (SciFinder-n technology) using NLP and neural networks to filter candidate molecules from 200M+ compounds by properties, availability and safety. Deployed across plastics, silicone, polyurethane and industrial-solutions businesses; won a 2023 CIO 100 award. [CAS (SciFinder-n)]
deployments_detail.value: Molecule identification cut from weeks to minutes; pilot narrowed millions of candidates to 8-12 safer options

deployments_detail.use: Machine learning for custom polyurethane product formulation ('Predictive Intelligence'): the model sorts through millions of possible fitting/formulation combinations and suggests areas for experimentation in seconds rather than months, using Dow's historical materials data. [Microsoft Azure Machine Learning]

Partnership with X (Alphabet's Moonshot Factory) to build an AI/ML sorting system and materials database for hard-to-recycle film and flexible plastics: a sensor-fusion system uses trained ML algorithms and spectrometers to identify the molecular composition of plastic packaging in real time (scanning thousands of pieces per minute), running as a pilot at a recycling plant. [Google / Alphabet X (Moonshot Factory)]

AI-enabled search and retrieval platform developed jointly with CAS to accelerate materials discovery, filtering scientific information across hundreds of millions of options; announced as the initial phase of a multi-phase collaboration. [CAS]
deployments_detail.value: Material search reduced from a weeks-long process to a matter of hours

deployments_detail.use: Edge computer-vision AI analyzes live plant camera feeds 24/7 to detect potential chemical containment leaks and alert operators via voice, text, email and mobile app. Built on Azure Video Analyzer with Azure IoT Edge/Hub and Azure Machine Learning for model training/retraining; adaptable to PPE detection and entrance-gate monitoring. [Microsoft Azure Video Analyzer / Azure IoT Edge / Azure ML]
